description: Get the NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day with explanation. Optionally specify a date. Example: get_apod({ date: "2024-01-15", _apiKey: "DEMO_KEY" })

_apiKey.description: NASA API key (optional, defaults to DEMO_KEY — get a free key at api.nasa.gov)

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional, defaults to today). Range: 1995-06-16 to today.

name: get_apod

date.description: Date of the astronomy picture in YYYY-MM-DD format

hd_url.description: URL to the high-definition version of the picture

title: Get Apod
